style_when: the story is regulatory or contractual — a filing, a mandate, a rate notice, a certificate, a purchase order that changed the economics
prompt: Overhead flat-lay photograph of a thick, embossed property insurance contract document resting on a dark walnut desk. A heavy brushed brass architectural scale ruler weighs down the paper, partially obscuring the complex printed columns. Shot with a 50mm flat-field macro lens, razor-sharp focal plane. Asymmetric top-down flatlay composition, placing the document off-centre to the right with generous negative space on the dark wood. Even diffused directional window daylight casting soft shadows, muted tactile paper tones, illegibly cropped text.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, watermarks, typography, ui, legible words
rationale: The story centers on the exact printed dollar figures and math hidden in the declarations page of an insurance policy, making a document flatlay the ideal visual metaphor.
subject: an embossed property insurance contract weighed down by a brass architectural ruler
core_thesis: A percentage deductible is charged against the dwelling limit, making it exceed the average claim and deciding the outcome of mid-sized losses.
core_conflict: Scaling asset value versus the fixed out-of-pocket risk burden.
